name: Reclaiming the Past
plugin: Wyrmstooth.esp (no other plugin edits the quest)
canDoWhy: Find the abandoned Fort Valus on Wyrmstooth, then ask Lurius Liore about it and buy the deed.

needs.what: Be on the island of Wyrmstooth with Lurius Liore around, which means getting there through the Wyrmstooth quests (Wyrmstooth, then Barrow of the Wyrm)

starts.where: Wyrmstooth; once Barrow of the Wyrm is over he works by day in the East Empire Company Tradehouse in Stonehollow and sleeps there
starts.how: Find the old abandoned fort on Wyrmstooth (Fort Valus), then ask Lurius about what happened to it. He tells you its history and sells you the deed.

firstStep: Ask Lurius Liore about Fort Valus

takesYou.why: the old fort you find and then buy
where Lurius works after the main Wyrmstooth story, to buy the deed and order upgrades

choices.leadsTo: The quest lists clean-up, a mess hall, armory, kitchen, bedroom, barracks, prison, garden and common house, plus hiring a crew; you go back to Lurius for each

objectives: Ask Lurius Liore about Fort Valus.
Speak to Lurius Liore about upgrading Fort Valus.

rewards.what: Fort Valus as your own fort (the deed)
rewards.when: when you buy it from Lurius

rewards.what: Fort upgrades and a hired crew
rewards.when: each time you pay Lurius for one

people.name: Lurius Liore
people.role: East Empire Company man who sells you the deed and the upgrades

unsure.why: The journal says the quest begins when you find the fort; what exactly sets it (entering the fort, discovering it on the map) isn't in these files. His deed dialogue is offered until you have bought it, so asking him first may also work, but I can't confirm it.
Lurius sits in a holding area until the Wyrmstooth scripts move him, so you can't meet him before that story starts. Whether he sells the fort during Barrow of the Wyrm or only after it isn't shown.

From his packages: after Barrow of the Wyrm he writes his ledger in the East Empire Company Tradehouse, sleeps there from midnight for 6 hours, and spends evenings from 7 pm for 5 hours at a tavern that isn't named in these files (probably The Handsome Hermit in Stonehollow). The tavern visit also depends on another quest these files don't name.
The price of the deed and of each upgrade isn't in these records. People placed at Fort Valus (a jailor, a blacksmith, workers) are probably the crew, but nothing here ties them to the upgrades.
The quest has a final hidden stage that ends it with no journal text; probably it closes once every upgrade is bought, but that isn't stated.
